new_task_1.title: Require a value for `workspace add --ref`
new_task_1.description: Conan 2.14.0 tightens `workspace add` CLI parsing so the `--ref` option must be followed by an explicit reference value, instead of being accepted as a bare flag with an omitted argument.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that `workspace add --ref` is only accepted when the user supplies an actual reference value to add to the workspace.

expectation.grounded: The `workspace add` command should define `--ref` as an option that requires one argument. Invocations that pass `--ref` without a following reference must fail during argument parsing instead of continuing with `args.ref=None` as if the option had been provided correctly.
expectation.conceptual: Users should get immediate CLI feedback when they choose the reference-based add mode but forget to provide the reference string, rather than falling through to later command logic with an incomplete request.

constraints.grounded: This change should only tighten validation for missing `--ref` values. Existing valid uses of `workspace add --ref <reference>` must continue to work, and path-based `workspace add <path>` usage must remain unchanged.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should improve command correctness without changing the normal workflow for adding either a package path or a fully specified reference.

behavior: `workspace add --ref <reference>` continues to accept an explicit reference value.
`workspace add --ref` with no value is rejected as invalid command-line input.
The command no longer treats a bare `--ref` flag as a partially specified request that proceeds into later workspace-add logic.
Path-based workspace addition remains available through the positional `path` argument.
acceptance_criteria: When a user runs `workspace add --ref pkg/1.0`, Conan should parse the command and proceed with the reference-based add flow.
When a user runs `workspace add --ref` without a following value, Conan should fail immediately with a CLI argument error indicating that `--ref` expects an argument.
When a user runs `workspace add <path>` without using `--ref`, the existing path-based workflow should remain unchanged.
